description: Superteam Earn (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The documented URL https://earn.superteam.fun/api/listings/ answers 308 to https://superteam.fun/api/listings (the base used here; opened 2026-09-24). Keyless JSON array with no documented query parameters: `query`, `category`, `min_budget`, `page` and `limit` are not sent and every open listing is returned (filter client-side). Fields per the feed: id, title, slug, type (bounty|project), rewardAmount, token, compensationType, minRewardAsk, maxRewardAsk, deadline, status, isFeatured, agentAccess, _count.Submission, sponsor{name,…}. `budget_min`/`budget_max` are the range asks (null for fixed rewards — read `raw.rewardAmount`). No URL field: the listing page is https://earn.superteam.fun/listing/<raw.slug>. Honour `raw.agentAccess`: HUMAN_ONLY listings must not receive agent-made submissions.
